recon.treatment_definition: Six different Zn application methods: soil (23 kg Zn ha-1), seed (ZnSO4 solution spray on seeds), leaf (0.4% ZnSO4 foliar spray), soil+leaf (combination), seed+leaf (combination)
recon.potential_tc_confusion: Seed treatment showed minimal effect on Zn concentration despite yield increases - ensure this is captured accurately
recon.sample_size_source: Experimental design was a factorial randomized complete-block design with four replications
recon.extraction_guidance: Extract grain Zn concentration data from Table 4 only. Control is 'no Zn application' row. Each Zn application method (soil, seed, leaf, soil+leaf, seed+leaf) vs control for each cultivar is a separate comparison. Use LSD values as variance measure. Table 4 formatting appears corrupted - carefully parse the actual data values for each cultivar and treatment combination. Focus on grain Zn concentration columns, not shoot concentration.
